declare
 v_sysdate date;
begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 if :s_shipment_no is not null then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :s_shipment_no is null then
 GO_ITEM('consignee_id');
 else
 begin
 select name, address_1, substr(address_2||' '|| address_3,1,50),
 city, state, zip
 into :ctrl_blk.s_name, :ctrl_blk.s_address_1, :ctrl_blk.s_address_2_3,
 :ctrl_blk.s_city, :ctrl_blk.s_state, :ctrl_blk.s_zip
 from consignee
 where consignee_id = :ctrl_blk.consignee_id 
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365) -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 begin
 select carrier, track_no, flight_no
 into :s_carrier, :track_no, :flight_no
 from shipments
 where shipment_no = :s_shipment_no
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 select code_desc into :s_code_desc
 from vserv_shippers
 where code = :s_carrier 
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 365); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 365); -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('4307');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 end if;
end;

/*************Consignee Id Lov before modification on 10/20/98 by Amit **************
select distinct co.consignee_id, 
 co.name, co.zone, 
 voc.order_class,

from consignee co, 
 vserv_order_classes voc 
where co.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id 
and voc.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id

 boxes bx, pick_slips ps,

 and bx.box_status = 'CL' 
 and co.consignee_id = ord.consignee_id
 and co.customer_id = ord.customer_id 
 and cu.customer_id = co.customer_id 
 and cu.customer_type

 and ord.order_no = ps.order_no 
 and ord.order_status in ('OR','BO','AL','PK')
 and ord.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and ord.insert_date >= (sysdate - :s_order_aging)

 and voc.order_class = ord.order_class 
 and cu.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id 
 and bx.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id

 and psp.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id ) 
order by voc.order_priority, co.zone

declare 
 v_local_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');

 select substr(bt.code_desc,1,10),
 substr(rtrim(su.user_last_name)||', '||rtrim(user_first_name),1,20),

 into :s_box_type,
 :s_packed_by,
 :s_packed_date

 where

 --su.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and

 :ctrl_blk_1.s_packed_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');

declare
 box_stat varchar2(2);
 box_cnt number;
 rp_cnt number;
 ord_cons_cnt number;
begin
 begin
 select box_status into box_stat
 from boxes
 where box_id = :ctrl_blk_1.box_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse

Trigger.Name: DO_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_ship_no VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_class VARCHAR2(2);
begin
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.box_id');
 if :ctrl_blk_1.box_id is Null
 then
 clear_record;
 else
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no is null
 then
 get_order_class(temp_class);
 gen_ship_no(temp_class,temp_ship_no);
 :s_shipment_no := temp_ship_no;
 begin
 insert into shipments
 (shipment_no, chapter_id, consignee_id,
 shipment_date, shipment_status, shipped_by_user_id,
 shipment_type, carrier, track_no, flight_no , program_id)
 values (:s_shipment_no, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :consignee_id,
 sysdate, 'OP', :banner.user_id, 'RE',
 :ctrl_blk.s_carrier, :ctrl_blk.track_no,
 :ctrl_blk.flight_no, 'SHIPMENT');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 put_in_box_table(:s_shipment_no, :ctrl_blk_1.box_id);
 update_prod_status(:ctrl_blk_1.box_id);
 set_ord_stat_sh(:ctrl_blk_1.box_id);
 update_active_to_shipped(:ctrl_blk_1.box_id);
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0600');
 /*0600 - Unsuccessful commit... transaction not saved */
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('0000');
 /*0000 - TRANSACTION COMMITTED */
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 test number := 0;
 FlgXml VARCHAR2(1);
 t_status VARCHAR2(6);
 vError VARCHAR2(100);
 pl_msg VARCHAR2(200);
 p_session_id VARCHAR2(30);
 pl_dl varchar2(20);
 pl_status varchar2(20);
 exec_loc VARCHAR2(100);
 rep_name VARCHAR2(30);
 t_customer_id consignee.customer_id%type;
 t_plasma_file_type customers.plasma_file_type%type;
 t_delimiter vserv_master.code_desc%type;
Begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := '5';
 commit;
 :system.message_level := '0';

 -- For the Electronc Delivery Note (EDN) enhancements, the following lines are added by Edwin on 08.20.2002
 -- In the customer table , the flag END_GEN_FLAG is set to Y then the system needs to generate the XML file

 
 begin
 select nvl(edn_gen_flag, 'N') 
 into FlgXml 
 from customers 
 where customer_id in (select customer_id 
 from consignee 
 where consignee_id = :ctrl_blk.consignee_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id) -- Added by Kishore on 02/10/2011. IM 4758
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id; -- Added by Kishore on 02/10/2011. IM 4758
 end;
 
 
 If FlgXml='Y' then
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 begin
 select customer_id
 into t_customer_id
 from consignee
 where consignee_id = :ctrl_blk.consignee_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_customer_id := null;
 show_error_dist('1300');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 if t_customer_id is not null then
 begin
 select plasma_file_type
 into t_plasma_file_type
 from customers
 where customer_id = t_customer_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error_dist('0302');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 show_error_dist('6600');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 begin
 select code_desc
 into t_delimiter
 from vserv_master
 where code_type = 'CSLFL'
 and code = 'DELIM'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error_dist('1521');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 if nvl(upper(t_plasma_file_type), '*') = 'XML' then
 xml_generator.gen_edn_xml(:ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no, t_status);
 elsif nvl(upper(t_plasma_file_type), '*') = 'CSL' then
 lt_plasma_csl_file_generator.gen_csl_file(:ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no, t_delimiter, t_status);
 elsif nvl(upper(t_plasma_file_type), '*') = 'EBL' then
 geltube_plasma.gen_ebl_file (:ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no, pl_Status );
 if pl_status<>'OK' then 
 message('EBL file did not get generated please check the log file');
 end if; 
 else
 show_error_dist('9938');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 
 --XML_GENERATOR.GEN_EDN_XML(:s_shipment_no,t_status); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 Synchronize;
 
 If nvl(upper(t_plasma_file_type), '*') = 'XML' then
 
 If t_status='OK' then
 if nvl(upper(t_plasma_file_type), '*') = 'XML' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 -- This Shell script will FTP the file from Unix to WIndows/NT environment
 --get the executable directory
 begin
 select code_desc into exec_loc from master_codes where code_type='LOGDR' and
 code='EXEC' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception when no_data_found then 
 message('EXEC code was not defined under the LOGDR type in the master code');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 
 host (exec_loc||'/XMLGEN.sh '||:s_shipment_no||'.xml', NO_SCREEN);
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2014. SCR 20597
 
 show_error_dist('4016'); 
 check_package_failure;
 elsif t_status='NOTOK' then 
 show_error_dist('4102');

procedure populate_zone is
 cursor zone is
 select distinct ord.consignee_id, substr(co.name,1,30) name,
 ord.order_class, ord.order_status
 from
 orders ord,
 consignee co
 where
 ord.order_status in ('OR','BO','AL','PK') and
 ord.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 ord.insert_date >= sysdate - :s_order_aging and
 ord.order_no in
 (select ps.order_no
 from pick_slips ps,
 pick_slip_products psp,
 boxes bx
 where
 bx.box_status = 'CL' and
 bx.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 bx.box_id = psp.box_id and
 psp.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 ps.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id) and
 co.consignee_id = ord.consignee_id and
 co.customer_id = ord.customer_id and
 co.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 co.zone = :GLOBAL.zone and
 co.consignee_id != :ctrl_blk.consignee_id
 order by 1;
begin
 go_block('zone');
 for zone_rec in zone
 loop
 :zone.z_consignee_id := zone_rec.consignee_id;
 :zone.z_name := zone_rec.name;
 :zone.z_order_class := zone_rec.order_class;
 :zone.z_order_status := zone_rec.order_status;
 down;
 end loop;
 up;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_DEFAULT_CHARGES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure add_default_charges IS
 cursor ship_charges is
 select charge_code, charge_code_desc, charge_code_type,
 charge, ship_flag, code_desc
 from vserv_charge_codes, vserv_master
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id
 and ship_flag in ('B','S')
 and code_type = 'CRDBI'
 and code = charge_code_type
 order by ship_flag desc;
 box_count number;
 i number;
begin
 select count(*)
 into box_count
 from boxes bx
 where bx.shipment_no = :ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no
 and bx.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id;
 select min(order_no)
 into :ctrl_blk.min_order_no
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps, boxes bx
 where bx.shipment_no = :ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no
 and bx.box_id = psp.box_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id =ps.pick_slip_id
 and bx.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id
 and ps.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id;
 loop
 exit when :charge_code is null;
 down;
 end loop;
 for rec in ship_charges
 loop
 for i in 1..box_count
 loop
 if rec.ship_flag = 'B' or i = 1
 then
 :shipment_charges.charge_code := rec.charge_code;
 :shipment_charges.description := rec.charge_code_desc;
 :shipment_charges.price := rec.charge;
 :shipment_charges.quantity := 1;
 :shipment_charges.amount := rec.charge * 1;
 :shipment_charges.cr_db_ind := rec.charge_code_type;
 :shipment_charges.cr_db_desc := rec.code_desc;
 :shipment_charges.chapter_id := :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id;
 :shipment_charges.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :shipment_charges.order_no := :min_order_no;
 :shipment_charges.shipment_no := :ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no;
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end loop;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS

procedure update_order_status (ord_no IN VARCHAR2) is
--This procedure updates the orders and order_items tables
 cursor c3 is
 select item_no
 from order_items
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and order_no = ord_no
 and item_status = 'PK';
 temp_count number;
 temp_item_no number;
begin
 for c3_rec in c3
 loop
 begin
 select
 count(distinct psp.unit_id || psp.product_code ||
 psp.aliquot)
 into temp_count
 from pick_slip_products psp , pick_slips ps
 where psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = ord_no
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and item_no = c3_rec.item_no
 and product_status not in ('SH', 'DL', 'RT');
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 update order_items
 set item_status = 'SH',
 program_id = 'SHIPMENT'
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and order_no = ord_no
 and item_no = c3_rec.item_no;
 end if;
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end;
 end loop;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from order_items
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and order_no = ord_no
 and item_status not in ('SH','CL','CA');
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 update orders
 set order_status = 'SH',
 program_id = 'SHIPMENT'
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and order_no = ord_no;
 end if;
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: INVOICE_S_PRINTER_I_LOV4
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,substr(code_desc,1,30) code_desc from rpt_master_codes where appl_id='DON' and code_type='FLP' and location_id = :global.warehouse order by seq

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_BOX_ID_LOV3
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT bx.box_id, ord.order_no, ord.order_class,
 TO_CHAR(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, ord.insert_date),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'),
 TO_CHAR(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, ord.est_arrival_time),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI')
FROM orders ord, boxes bx
WHERE ord.consignee_id = :ctrl_blk.consignee_id
AND ord.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
AND ord.order_status IN ('OR','BO','AL','PK')
AND bx.box_status = 'CL'
AND bx.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
AND bx.warehouse_id = :global.warehouse
AND ord.order_no IN
 (SELECT ps.order_no
 FROM pick_slip_products psp1,
 pick_slips ps
 WHERE bx.box_id = psp1.box_id
 AND psp1.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 AND psp1.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 AND ps.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 )
AND NOT EXISTS
 (SELECT 'x'
 FROM pick_slip_products psp
 WHERE psp.chapter_id = bx.chapter_id
 AND psp.box_id = bx.box_id
 AND psp.product_status = 'RP'
 )
ORDER BY 5, 3, 4, 2, 1

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_S_CARRIER_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code, code_desc from vserv_shippers where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_CONSIGNEE_I_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct co.consignee_id, co.name, co.zone, voc.order_class, voc.order_priority from consignee co, vserv_order_classes voc where /*modified by hcl consulting*/ co.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id and voc.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id and /*modified by hcl consulting*/ exists (select 'x' from orders ord, customers cu, boxes bx, pick_slips ps, pick_slip_products psp where bx.box_id = psp.box_id and bx.box_status = 'CL' and co.consignee_id = ord.consignee_id and co.customer_id = ord.customer_id and cu.customer_id = co.customer_id and cu.customer_type not in ('DI','LC','RD') and ord.order_no = ps.order_no and ord.order_status in ('OR','BO','AL','PK') and ord.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and /*ord.insert_date >= (sysdate - :s_order_aging) and*/ ps.pick_slip_id=psp.pick_slip_id and voc.order_class = ord.order_class and /*modified by hcl consulting*/ cu.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id and bx.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id and bx.warehouse_id = :global.warehouse and ps.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id and psp.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id ) /*modified by hcl consulting*/ order by voc.order_priority, co.zone

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_S_SHIPMENT__LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT sh.shipment_no, sh.consignee_id, SUBSTR(co.name, 1, 30),
 TO_CHAR(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, sh.shipment_date), 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI')
FROM shipments sh, consignee co
WHERE sh.invoice_printed_date IS NULL
AND sh.shipment_status = 'OP'
AND sh.shipment_type = 'RE'
AND co.consignee_id = sh.consignee_id
AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE) BETWEEN co.eff_date AND NVL(co.term_date, sysdate + 365)
AND
 /*modified by hcl consulting*/
 sh.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id
AND co.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id
 /*modified by hcl consulting*/
ORDER BY sh.shipment_date,
 sh.shipment_no
